title: Strong Legendre regularity and short-time analysis of abnormal curves
summary: We study strictly abnormal sub-Riemannian extremals satisfying the Goh condition and a strong (i.e., coercive) generalized Legendre condition, imposed only at the Lebesgue points of the reference control. We prove that such a control is smooth, that the projected extended Hessian of the end-point map is uniformly coercive on the admissible set of variations for short times, and that the abnormal covector gives a quantitative separation of the end-point of the reference arc from the image of the admissible set under the nonlinear end-point map.
